_comment: Single source of truth for satoshistatues.com. Edit here, then run: python3 build.py

config._newsletter_help: Paste your Buttondown embed-subscribe URL to switch on email alerts, e.g. https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/YOUR_USERNAME . Empty = coming-soon note with feed link. Then run: python3 build.py
config._nostr_help: Nostr profile for the site. nostr_hex is served as NIP-05 _@satoshistatues.com via /.well-known/nostr.json. Then run: python3 build.py
config._photo_help: Photo submissions: the CTA builds a mailto link in JS from photo_email_user + photo_email_domain (kept split so no plain address appears in the HTML). photo_x_handle is shown as the X alternative.
config._leaderboard_help: Leaderboard API (Cloudflare Worker in /workspace/leaderboard). Statue coordinates for its server-side distance check come from `python3 build.py --worker`.

statues.name: Budapest
statues.note: World’s first Satoshi statue. Reflective face so visitors see themselves (“We are all Satoshi”). Free public access 24/7.
statues.access: Outdoors in Graphisoft Park. Can be visited 24/7, free of charge (per the statue’s official site).
statues.label: Satoshi Statue Budapest

visit.getting_there:
From OpenStreetMap (straight-line distances; lines and timetables unverified): the nearest bus stops are Sujtás utca (about 400 m) and Záhony utca (about 470 m). The nearest rail stops are the Aquincum railway halt (about 780 m) and the Kaszásdűlő HÉV suburban-rail stop (about 800 m).

Parking: OpenStreetMap shows a 120-space surface lot about 180 m away. Whether it's public or for park tenants only is unverified.
visit.exact_spot:
In Graphisoft Park, Záhony u. 7, 1031 Budapest (District III), per the official site. Köztérkép, the Hungarian public-art register, places it on the green area in front of the Microsoft building, facing the Heracles (Herkules) statue. In OpenStreetMap, the Herkules statue is about 15 m away and the Microsoft office about 40 m. Pin: 47.56072, 19.05438 (OpenStreetMap node 9843217531).

It is not in City Park (Városliget), despite what some listings say.
visit.photo_tip:
This isn't a see-through design. The face is a polished bronze-aluminium composite, so every visitor can see their own face in it (official site).

Generic tip (not from a source): shoot close so your reflection sits inside the hood, and keep the sun behind you to avoid flare.
visit.hours_access: Outdoors. The official site says it can be visited 24/7, free of charge.
visit.nearby_note: None within 1 km on BTC Map (checked 2026-10-21).

statues.name: Lugano
statues.note: First of the optical-illusion series. Unveiled in Parco Ciani in Oct 2024, it was later moved to the Foce, the mouth of the Cassarate river, where vandals threw it into Lake Lugano on the night of 1–2 Aug 2025; divers recovered it in pieces. The artist repaired it with the kintsugi technique and it was re-inaugurated on 24 Oct 2025 in the central area of Parco Ciani, near the Dying Socrates sculpture. On 19 Apr 2026 it was vandalized again and found seriously damaged in its central body. An OpenStreetMap mapper noted it was no longer at its originally mapped spot as of 28 Jul 2026; current status unconfirmed.
statues.access: In Parco Ciani, a public park open every day: 6:30–23:30 (March–October) and 6:30–21:00 (November–February).
statues.label: Satoshi Statue Lugano

visit.getting_there:
Check that the statue is actually on display before you go (see Hours & access).

From OpenStreetMap (straight-line distances from the 2024 statue position; routes unverified): the Palazzo Congressi bus stop is about 130 m away, and the Lugano Centro bus hub (TPL) about 360 m.

Parking: the paid underground Autosilo Piazza Castello is about 135 m away (OpenStreetMap).
visit.exact_spot: In Parco Ciani, Lugano's lakefront park. The statue was first installed there in Oct 2024 (pin 46.00441, 8.95659, OpenStreetMap node 12288711744), then moved to the Foce (Cassarate river mouth), where it was thrown into the lake on 1–2 Aug 2025. On 24 Oct 2025 it was re-inaugurated in the central area of Parco Ciani, near the "Dying Socrates" sculpture (Corriere del Ticino; Il Giornale del Ticino). That exact spot may differ from the 2024 pin and is unverified.
visit.photo_tip:
It's a Satoshigallery design, so the figure reads from the side and nearly vanishes from the front. After the April 2026 damage, its current look is unknown.

Generic tip (not from a source): if it's on display, the lake makes a clean background for a head-on shot.
visit.hours_access: Current status unconfirmed. It was found seriously damaged on 19 Apr 2026 (RSI; Ticinonline), and an OpenStreetMap mapper noted it was no longer there as of 28 Jul 2026. Parco Ciani itself is open daily from 6:30 to 23:30 (March–October) and 6:30 to 21:00 (November–February), per the City of Lugano.

statues.name: El Zonte
statues.note: Located in the famous Bitcoin Beach community that helped inspire El Salvador’s Bitcoin adoption. It was first presented at Museo Marte in San Salvador in Feb 2025 and arrived at Bitcoin Beach in Apr 2025, as part of a new public space opened by the Ministry of Public Works.
statues.label: Satoshi Statue El Zonte

visit.getting_there:
We couldn't verify bus routes to El Zonte. OpenStreetMap shows an unnamed bus stop about 180 m from the statue, on the coastal road (Carretera del Litoral).

Parking: OpenStreetMap marks a surface parking area about 330 m away. Fees are unverified.
visit.exact_spot: In the public beachfront space at Playa El Zonte (Bitcoin Beach), La Libertad, which El Salvador's Ministry of Public Works opened in April 2025. Satoshigallery's own map pin is 13.4954011, -89.4424197. The Bitcoin Beach Office is about 85 m away (BTC Map/OpenStreetMap).
visit.photo_tip:
It's a Satoshigallery design, so the figure is visible from the side and nearly disappears from the front. The best angle at this site is unverified.

Generic tip (not from a source): with the sea behind it, shooting head-on makes the see-through effect obvious, and late-afternoon light is softer.
visit.hours_access: Outdoors in a public space with beach showers, water stations and a calisthenics area (El Salvador in English, citing the Ministry of Public Works). No hours or fees are published, so treat both as unverified.

statues.name: Tokyo
statues.note: At Tokyo Bitcoin Base near Yotsuya Station.
statues.label: Satoshi Statue Tokyo

visit.getting_there:
Tokyo Bitcoin Base lists its access as a 6-minute walk from Yotsuya Station, and a 9-minute walk from both Ichigaya Station and Akebonobashi Station. That's from the venue's website as archived in Nov 2025. The live site showed a maintenance notice on 2026-10-21.

Per OpenStreetMap, the nearest Yotsuya Station entrance is about 320 m away, and Akebonobashi (Toei Subway, S03) about 640 m. Parking is unverified.
visit.exact_spot: Outside Tokyo Bitcoin Base, 2-8 Yotsuya-Honshiocho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo 160-0003 (Forbes: the statue "sits outside of Tokyo Bitcoin Base"). Forbes describes the building as four stories on a relatively quiet block. Pin: 35.68897, 139.72854 (OpenStreetMap node for Tokyo Bitcoin Base).
visit.photo_tip:
It's a Satoshigallery design, so the figure is visible from the side and nearly disappears from the front. Take both angles. The exact best viewpoint at this site is unverified.

Generic tip (not from a source): it's a street-side spot, so go early or late to avoid passers-by in the frame.
visit.hours_access: The statue is outdoors outside the building. Opening hours for viewing it are unverified. Inside, the co-working space offers drop-ins on weekdays from 10:00 to 18:00 for ¥5,500 per day, with Lightning accepted, per the archived Nov 2025 site.

nearby.name: Tokyo Bitcoin Base
nearby.note: The statue's host venue, with paid drop-in co-working.

nearby.name: Cocorotus Foodtruck
nearby.note: Listed at the Base. Its archived site says the food truck runs Tue, Wed and Fri from 11:00 to 14:00.

nearby.note: Food truck listed at the Base. It also appears at other spots nearby, so its location varies.

statues.name: Hanoi
statues.place: 1Matrix HQ, Century Tower (16th floor), Times City
statues.note: Inside the Blockchain Gallery at 1Matrix headquarters, which 1Matrix lists on the 16th floor of the Century building, Times City, 458 Minh Khai (whether the gallery itself is on that floor is unverified). Reported open to the public on Saturdays in Sep 2025; hours unverified. The map pin is a third-party location for the building, so it is approximate.
statues.access: Indoors in the Blockchain Gallery at 1Matrix headquarters (Century building, Times City). Reported open to the public every Saturday (Sep 2025); hours unverified.
statues.label: Satoshi Statue Hanoi

visit.getting_there:
Buses only, as far as we could verify. OpenStreetMap shows the "T1 Vinhomes Times City" (about 130 m) and "Khu đô thị Times City" (about 240 m) stops near the complex's centre. Routes and the walk to the Century building are unverified.

Parking: unverified.
visit.exact_spot: Indoors in the Blockchain Gallery at 1Matrix headquarters in Times City (Viet Nam News). 1Matrix gives its address as 16th floor, Century building, Times City, 458 Minh Khai, Hanoi. Whether the gallery is on that same floor is unverified. A third-party listing pins the Century building at about 20.99732, 105.86837 (unverified).
visit.photo_tip:
It's a Satoshigallery design: seen from an angle, Satoshi's profile is visible, and from the front it fades to near transparency (Viet Nam News). Take both angles.

Generic tip (not from a source): it's indoors, so turn off your flash to avoid glare on the metal slats.
visit.hours_access: Indoors. In Sep 2025 it was reported open to the public every Saturday (Viet Nam News; VNA), with no hours given. Confirm with 1Matrix before you go, because this hasn't been re-verified since.
visit.nearby_note: None within 1 km on BTC Map (checked 2026-10-21).

statues.access: Indoors at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE museum). The NYSE building is not open to the general public, so the statue is not freely accessible.

statues.name: Fornelli
statues.note: Municipality-funded monument. The village has high Bitcoin merchant adoption.
statues.label: Satoshi Statue Fornelli

visit.getting_there:
We couldn't verify any bus or rail service to Fornelli, and OpenStreetMap shows no public transport stops within about 1 km. Plan on arriving by car (local bus options are unverified).

Parking: OpenStreetMap marks a small car park right beside the piazza, about 15 m away. Fees and capacity are unverified.
visit.exact_spot: In Piazza Umberto I, Fornelli (province of Isernia, Molise), installed at the belvedere (Comune di Fornelli; ANSA). Pin: 41.60700, 14.14047 (OpenStreetMap node 12804537475).
visit.photo_tip:
This is not a Satoshigallery piece. It's by local crypto-artist Mattia Pannoni, but it has a similar effect: seen from the front, it seems to disappear (ANSA, quoting the artist). Take one frontal shot and one side shot to show it.

Generic tip (not from a source): the belvedere puts open sky behind the statue, which makes the see-through effect easier to read.
visit.hours_access: Outdoors in a public square. No hours are published. It should be viewable at any time, but that is our assumption and is unverified.

statues.name: Kranj Bitcoin Monument
statues.note: Often called the world’s first public Bitcoin monument. Large Corten steel structure featuring the Bitcoin “B” symbol (about 3 tonnes). Located on a roundabout near the city center. Linked to Slovenia’s early crypto scene (supported by Bitstamp).
statues.label: Kranj Bitcoin Monument

visit.getting_there:
From OpenStreetMap (straight-line distances; routes and timetables unverified): Kranj bus station (Avtobusna postaja Kranj) is about 260 m away, and Kranj railway station (Železniška postaja Kranj) about 1.1 km.

Parking: OpenStreetMap shows a paid surface car park about 30 m from the roundabout.
visit.exact_spot: In the roundabout in front of the Kranj courthouse (RTV Slovenija). OpenStreetMap names it "Bitcoin krožišče" (Bitcoin roundabout), and the District Court (Okrožno sodišče v Kranju) is about 40 m away. Pin: 46.24636, 14.35781 (OpenStreetMap node 5903169142).
visit.photo_tip:
This isn't a see-through design. RTV Slovenija notes that the monument can best be seen from the air.

Generic tip (not from a source): shoot diagonally from a sidewalk corner so the tilted ring and the B symbol both read, and wait for a gap in traffic.
visit.hours_access: It sits in an active traffic circle, so view it from the surrounding sidewalks and don't walk into the roundabout. As a street monument it has no opening hours.
visit.nearby_note: None within 1 km on BTC Map (checked 2026-10-21).

statues.name: Miami Bitcoin Bull
statues.place: Miami Dade College Wolfson Campus (NE 1st Ave & NE 4th St)
statues.note: Chrome/fiberglass robotic bull with blue laser eyes, commissioned by TradeStation and designed by Furio Tedeschi. Debuted at the Bitcoin 2022 conference in Miami Beach, then moved to its permanent home at Miami Dade College. A modern take on the Wall Street bull.
statues.label: Miami Bitcoin Bull

visit.getting_there:
Per OpenStreetMap, the Metromover's College North station is about 90 m away, and College Bayside about 200 m. A Miami-Dade Transit bus stop at NE 1st Avenue and NE 4th Street is about 55 m away. Metrorail Government Center (about 490 m) and Brightline MiamiCentral (about 400 m) are also close. Routes and schedules are unverified.

Parking: OpenStreetMap shows Miami Parking Authority Garage 3, paid, about 200 m away, plus Miami Dade College garages nearby whose public access is unverified.
visit.exact_spot: At the edge of Miami Dade College's Wolfson Campus in front of Building 1000, with its eyes facing NE 1st Avenue (MDC The Reporter). The site data puts it at NE 1st Ave and NE 4th St. Pin: 25.77820, -80.19186 (OpenStreetMap node 10677295005).
visit.photo_tip:
This isn't a see-through design. It's an 11-foot chrome-and-fiberglass bull with blue "laser" eyes.

Generic tips (not from a source): shoot low and slightly to one side so the horns and eyes stand out against the sky, and try dusk if the eyes are lit (unverified).
visit.hours_access: Outdoors on an open campus. MDC The Reporter described visitors walking up for selfies, and TradeStation calls MDC the bull's permanent home. We found no posted hours, so viewing hours are unverified.

statues.name: Vienna
statues.place: Viertel Zwei (lakehead next to OMV Hoch Zwei)
statues.note: Unveiled Oct 14, 2026 by Bitcoin Austria for its 15th anniversary. Crowdfunded with over 1.3 BTC from 120+ donors (Genesis sponsor Bitpanda). Open to the public 24/7, near U2 Krieau.
statues.access: Outdoors at the head of the lake in Viertel Zwei, open to the public around the clock. Nearest U-Bahn: Krieau (U2).
statues.label: Satoshi Statue Vienna

visit.getting_there:
Take the U-Bahn U2 to Krieau, then walk toward the OMV Hoch Zwei building until you reach the start of the lake. Those are Bitcoin Austria's own directions.

Per OpenStreetMap, Krieau (U2) station is about 130 m from the statue in a straight line, and a Krieau bus stop is about 170 m away. Bus route numbers are unverified.

Parking: the paid multi-storey Messe Parkhaus D is about 180 m away (OpenStreetMap). Rates and opening hours are unverified.
visit.exact_spot: At the head of the lake (Seeanfang) in Viertel Zwei, right next to the OMV Hoch Zwei building, 1020 Vienna (Leopoldstadt). Pin: 48.21351, 16.41363 (OpenStreetMap node 14287266624).
visit.photo_tip:
Bitcoin Austria says the figure is clearly visible from the side and almost invisible from the front, so take one shot from each angle to show the disappearing effect. Their party trick is to have a friend stand behind the statue. Everyone in front then sees that person's reflection in Satoshi's face, as in "We are all Satoshi".

Generic tip (not from a source): the 61 steel profiles are mirror-polished, so watch for glare and your own reflection in direct sun.
visit.hours_access: Outdoors and publicly accessible at any time (Bitcoin Austria: "jederzeit öffentlich zugänglich", "Öffentlich, im Freien"). No admission fee is mentioned. Bitcoin Austria's "free entry" note was for the unveiling event.

nearby.note: Accommodation, about 670 m. The only BTC Map listing within 1 km.

nearby.name: Heines
nearby.note: Café at Heinestraße 42, about 1.8 km, so outside the 1 km radius.

upcoming21.summary: Community fundraiser by Jednadvacet.org (The Malahar Network z.s.), launched 12 June 2026 at BTC Prague. The 1 BTC base goal (the fixed price of the statue from Satoshi Gallery) was reached; the maximum target is 1.3 BTC to cover shipping, customs, VAT and installation. On 10 Aug 2026 the organizers reported about 1.26 BTC raised, said the location was being negotiated with Prague City Hall, and expected delivery around the turn of the year (2026/27).
